note: The World Inequality Database (WID.world, bulk download of 15 October 2026, read again in that of 30 October 2026), Guernsey, 2024: average net personal wealth (ahweal992j) and average post-tax national income (adiinc992j) per adult over 20, resources split equally within couples, for the bottom 20, 40, 60, 90 and 99 percent and the top 1 percent; each family's band is read from them. The database's metadata leaves the figures' currency blank; its market exchange rate in local currency per US dollar (xlcusx999i), whose metadata says of 1960 to 2024 "Currency assumed to be GBP", is 0.7824145555496216 for 2024, the same as its rate for the United Kingdom (GB), so they are read as GBP, as the database's own rates state them to be. Read 2026-10-31. Read again 2026-11-03 from the bulk download of 30 October 2026 (its country files dated 30 October 2026): every row quoted here, its year and its currency label stood as before, and no later year was given. Until 2026-11-03 this note and its sources wrote the variable codes with their age and population parts swapped (ahwealj992 for ahweal992j and adiincj992 for adiinc992j, xlcusxi999 for xlcusx999i), codes no file of the database holds (its README: type, concept, age group, population, as in sptinc992j), and called adiinc992j post-tax disposable income, which its metadata names post-tax national income ([Post-tax national income]=[Post-tax disposable income]+[Public spending]). The national accounts (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-03: each band's income scaled by households' disposable income over national income), searched again on 2026-11-03 in the statistics office's own accounts for a households' disposable income account from 2019 on, found none: States of Guernsey 'Gross Value Added and Gross Domestic Product' page (gov.gg/gdp), read 2026-11-03: GVA and GDP; no household sector account or GNI. Each band's income stayed the database's post-tax national income, public spending included.
